## Core Services
1. Fully Agentic Application Development: Autonomous multi-agent swarms constructing robust production applications under architectural contracts and self-healing test loops.
2. Spec-Kit AI Systems & Workflows: Transforming enterprise requirements into formal, executable domain specifications before agentic synthesis.
3. Enterprise Software Architecture: High-throughput Java 21 / Spring Boot and PHP 8.3 / Symfony microservices, CQRS, Event-Driven, Azure Cloud (Bicep/ARM).
4. High-Load Data & Spatial Telemetry: Databricks, Azure Data Factory, IoT recursive asset tracking engines, Smallworld & ESRI GIS.

## Open-Source Product: Gridwright (apsw-gridwright)
- What: React data grid on a headless engine; local arrays and paginating APIs share one pipeline, negotiated through data-source capabilities.
- Latest release: 0.22.1 (2026-10-24). MIT, zero runtime dependencies, about 17 kB gzipped, React 18 and 19, TypeScript, optional MUI package (apsw-gridwright-mui).
- Features: sorting, selection, paging, search, column filters, tree data, grouping with aggregates, CSV/Excel/Markdown/print/PDF export, row and column virtualization (up to ten million rows), inline editing, column layout, row detail, URL sync, WCAG 2.2 AA add-on, translations en/de/es/fr/pl.
- Pro tier: planned, not priced yet (additional add-ons, priority support, migration help).
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/apsw-gridwright
- Source: https://github.com/yaotzin1/apsw-gridwright
- Live playground: https://yaotzin1.github.io/apsw-gridwright/examples/playground/index.html
- Docs: https://yaotzin1.github.io/apsw-gridwright/docs/getting-started.html
- Built by one architect with the Indaba engine and coding agents under a single workflow.ai.yml; the same delivery standard is offered to B2B teams: https://apsw.pl/#assurance
